name: Debug Bar
description: Add a debug bar that displays useful information about the current request.
project_description: This module integrates the PHP Debug Bar library (maximebf/debugbar) into Drupal to display information about the current request in an on-page bar: Drupal log messages, POST and GET variables, site settings, route name and parameters, PHP info, memory usage, and exceptions. It is a development aid and its maintainers state it should not be enabled in a production environment. It requires the Vendor Stream Wrapper module and the maximebf/debugbar Composer package. There is no configuration UI; enabling the module starts displaying the bar. The debugbar_twig submodule adds a Twig-rendering profiler pane.
